title: One-step correspondence for framed configurations
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $j$ be one of its work-tape indices, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a six-tape configuration of the timed interpreter on $x$. Choose arbitrary contents and head positions for the work tapes of $M$. Form a configuration of the capture machine by keeping $c$’s input-head position and output, placing $c$’s fifth work tape in tape $j$, and placing its other five work tapes in the five added tapes in their prescribed order; label its control state by the timed-interpreter component of the capture machine’s state space. One step of the capture machine from this configuration equals the configuration formed in the same way from the timed interpreter’s one-step successor of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet
A chosen work-tape index of that machine
A six-tape timed-interpreter configuration on that input
Arbitrary work-tape contents for the machine
Arbitrary work-tape head positions for the machine
replaced:
One step of the assembled capture machine from a framed configuration equals
the frame of one step of the timed interpreter, including the final halting
transition.
